_notes.source: scripts/analyze_vase.py on outputs/derived/world_pos.npy (opacity > 100), world metres, Z up. Raw numbers in data/params/vase_measured.json.
_notes.vessel: Horizontal slices (1.5 cm) of splat centres between z 0.755 and 1.04 are clearly ELLIPTICAL, not round: major axis at 46 deg from +X, centred at (-0.040, 0.015). Per-slice 1st/99th percentile extents along the major (u) and minor (v) axes give the semi axes; profile below is semi-major / max (0.153 m) and minor/major ratio. Uncertainty ~ +-0.5 cm (splat centres sit slightly inside the surface; back side (-v) is sparsely observed).
_notes.vessel_base_z: table disc top measured at z 0.747 (median of disc splats); lowest vessel slice 0.762, so the vessel rests at ~0.752. Table disc is at z 0.7513 (data/params/table.json); base set to 0.749 so the vessel sits 2 mm into the disc (no floating gap).
_notes.vessel_rim: top of brown splats at z 1.033-1.04; opening semi axes ~0.093 x 0.055.
_notes.holes: located by ray-casting the dark hole pixel of the hero (443,420) and detail_vase (397,508) references onto the fitted ellipse: both give phi 62 deg (ellipse parameter from +u toward +v), z 0.84. Diameter from pixel size in both views ~3.2 cm. A second, smaller gap in the splat coverage at phi ~290 deg, z ~0.85 (back side) is less certain. Round 3: the back hole seen in the opposite (500,250) and right (485,255) references ray-casts to phi 300-302 deg, z 0.85-0.87 in both; its width ~14-20 px at ~3.2 mm/px gives a ~4.2 cm diameter.
_notes.arrangement_frame: The whole dried arrangement is a flat, fan-like composition in a vertical plane at 55 deg from +X through the vessel centre (top-view PCA). Arrangement coordinates: s along (cos55, sin55), n along (-sin55, cos55) (n > 0 faces the hero camera), z = world height.
_notes.fan: Cream palm fan: front layer (n ~ +0.045) of pale (230,204,164) splats, a dark vertical petiole at s ~ -0.02 from the mouth (z 1.03) to the hub at z ~1.15; blade tips from s -0.19 z 1.05 (lower left) round to s 0.0 z 1.29; detail_vase pixel picks of tips gave world points that map to radii 0.13-0.17 m from the hub. Round 1 correction: hero rays through the fan's convergence point and four blade tips, intersected with the n=0.045 plane, put the hub at (s -0.01, z 1.085) with tips 0.16-0.20 m away between 62 and 196 deg; the 3D blade tips agree. Detail pass: close_vase reference shows ~13-16 broad straw spears (width ~0.28 of length) with split two-pointed tips, pleated base and an exposed straight petiole; rebuilt as Garden Vase Fan Spear variants with uneven spacing/length/tilt/roll. Lighting agent: fan straw 0.24 vs ref 0.36 in close_vase after lighting fit -> fan translucency 0.6 with a warm light transmission colour (thin dried palm back-lit by the +y sky) and a 10 deg back-lean of the upper spears (scan PCA allows ~0-10 deg). r010 reviewer: grey-ochre and over-pleated -> warmer cream albedo (246,228,188), shallower central fold (0.15-0.35) and secondary pleats (0.08 of half-width, 2 ridges), fainter leaf lines; translucency 0.6 kept. Orbit r011 (frames 0/72/144): reference fan is a round palmate disc on a long petiole, hub ~0.11 m above the rim (frame 72 face-on view; agrees with the dark petiole in the splat rising to z 1.15 and with the original 3D blade-tip fit), spread -20..215 deg, segments ~0.15 m, joined over the inner ~45 % and split at the tips. The earlier hero-ray hub (z 1.085) was biased by overlapping lower blades and is superseded.
_notes.pods: Orange-tan pointed leaves (median sRGB 180,139,95; tips 208,148,99) occupy s 0.0..0.23, z 1.05..1.25 with n spread -0.05..+0.06: modelled as fronds radiating from the mouth toward +s and up.
_notes.ball: pale tan sphere: centre (s 0.230, n 0.041, z 1.178), radius 0.033 (point extents 0.031-0.052 incl. splat size).
_notes.bloom: grey-white rough ball: centre (s 0.066, n 0.011, z 1.241), radius ~0.03.
_notes.shell: cream spiral cone: centre (s 0.015, n 0.003, z 1.259), axis ~vertical, ~7 cm long.
_notes.cones: two dark brown scaly elongated cones near (s 0.164, n 0.019, z 1.249) and (s 0.133, n 0.016, z 1.267), ~8-9 cm long; axes from the plane-view plot, uncertain +-15 deg.
_notes.colours: sRGB picks from the reference renders (they include overcast light): vessel lit 125,95,65 / dark patch 70,50,35; fan cream 228,200,150; pods 205,140,90 with dark roots 115,70,40; ball 215,165,120; bloom 205,200,190; cone 105,78,52. Cycles check (lighting fitted): vessel rendered 0.76-0.87x and fan 0.57x the reference box means, so vessel albedo was raised ~1.2x; the fan is already near-white albedo -- its PCA plane normal is horizontal (yaw 146, elev -3 deg), so the remaining fan deficit is light/view-dependent splat brightness, not geometry. Round r007: dark stain centred at phi 110 deg, z 0.85 (ray-cast of the detail_vase dark patch pixel (470,480)); fan albedo warmed to golden straw and given per-piece translucency 0.25 (vase_trans) because it is back-lit from the +y sky; vessel desaturated for the opposite view. Detail pass (user: 'missing dirt', 'not enough shininess'): r008 close_vase stats ref vs ours: highlight spread p99-p50 111 vs 75, dark-grime fraction 0.25 vs 0.19, median 100 vs 109 -> polished husk (roughness 0.28-0.58, +0.25 on grime/fibres, specular 0.6), dark fibrous grime patches, light colour slightly lowered. Lighting agent: vessel lit side ~1.5x too bright under the final lighting -> vessel colours x0.82 sRGB (~0.65 linear). r009: x0.82 overshot (close_vase lit 113 vs ref 138, lower flank 69 vs 127) -> lit colour back up ~1.2x, dark/stain/grime lifted, base darkening reduced; fan albedo desaturated to pale straw (236,218,176), translucency kept. r010 integrated close_vase (ref / r010): vessel lit 138/123, lower 127/86, right 129/105; pods 167,121,79 / 146,84,49 (too saturated, G/R 0.58 vs 0.72) -> vessel light x1.13, dark/patch/stain/grime lifted ~1.25x, grime 0.45; pods to duller tan-rust (212,150,98).
_notes.balls: Back-layer seed balls: blobs in the n<0 point layer viewed from -N (scratch analysis in scripts/analyze_vase.py --back), confirmed in the opposite/right references (several wooden and scaly balls). Centres = blob centre with n moved ~0.6 r toward +n because splat centres sit on the visible (-n) surface. kind 0 smooth, 1 scaly. Uncertainty ~1 cm.
_notes.asymmetry: Shoulder/lip/bulge asymmetry is fitted by eye to the hero, detail_vase, left, right and opposite references (opening reads offset toward -u, rim lower on the +u end, lower +u flank fuller); the slice centres themselves vary < 1 cm, so these are small (1-1.5 cm) and exposed via the Asymmetry control. Detail pass: least-squares drift of the slice centres (vessel_axis_slope in vase_measured.json: dx/dz -0.054, dy/dz +0.053 world) = lean of 0.076 m/m toward +v (toward the hero camera) applied as a shear; S-shaped egg lean (+u flank full low, -u flank full high, 7 %) and narrower rounded base (0.5 of max at the disc) fitted by eye to close_vase.
_notes.twigs: Fine dried twigs/fibres: count and spread judged from the hero/detail references (thin dark strands between the pods and fan, fibres right of the fan); not resolvable individually in the splat.
_notes.fibres: Reviewer: pale streaks on the vessel in the splat are partly reconstruction streaks; husk fibres kept faint (0.12).
